item.title: Four suspects arrested in Martin County after armed robbery of teen and police pursuit

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation draws international artists to Fort Pierce's historic Crain Estate
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, preserving the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain while hosting artists from around the world in the Peacock Arts District.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: The 44-year-old tennis star withdrew from the doubles match after suffering a right knee injury during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina advances to World Cup round of 16 with 3-2 win over Cape Verde
item.description: Lionel Messi scored his 20th career World Cup goal as Argentina survived a challenge from Cape Verde in a thrilling match that required extra time in South Florida.
